acceptance.given: A dependency declaration is evaluated without an explicit required or optional kind.

oracle.expected: Validation fails with a typed diagnostic identifying the missing dependency kind.
forbidden: Validation accepts the declaration without a required or optional kind.
The dependency kind remains ambiguous in a passing result.
oracle.observable: The validator result contains a missing-kind diagnostic and failure status.

acceptance.then: The declaration is rejected until its dependency kind is explicitly recorded.
acceptance.when: The package validator evaluates the dependency declaration.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the dependency declaration case whose required/optional kind is absent and assert the typed missing-kind failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate that every dependency declaration explicitly identifies required or optional kind.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema change; reverting the validator implementation restores prior behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Dependency metadata moves from unclassified to explicitly classified or blocking-invalid.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator fails when kind is absent and accepts declarations with required or optional kind.

acceptance.given: A dependency declaration is evaluated without a compatible version and without a repository-owned authority reference.

oracle.expected: Validation fails with a typed diagnostic identifying the missing or invalid compatibility basis.
forbidden: Validation accepts a dependency lacking both compatible version and repository-owned authority reference.
A non-authoritative or incompatible reference produces a pass.
oracle.observable: The validator result records a compatibility-or-authority diagnostic and failure status.

acceptance.then: The declaration is rejected until it provides a compatible version or repository-owned authority reference.
acceptance.when: The package validator evaluates dependency identity and compatibility metadata.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the dependency declaration case lacking a compatible version and repository-owned authority reference and assert blocking validation failure.

affected_subjects: Dependency declaration compatibility or authority reference
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require a compatible version or repository-owned authority reference for every dependency.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema change; reverting the validator implementation restores prior compatibility behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Dependency metadata moves from ungrounded to authority/version grounded or blocking-invalid.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator blocks missing or invalid compatibility authority and accepts a valid basis.

acceptance.given: A Skill declares routing or orchestration behavior while its metadata classifies it as a leaf Skill.

oracle.expected: Acceptance verification fails and identifies the routing declaration with the false leaf classification.
forbidden: A routing or orchestration Skill passes under a false leaf classification.
Leaf-only handling suppresses the routing classification failure.
oracle.observable: The verifier result records a failing status naming the inconsistent routing and leaf metadata.

acceptance.then: The acceptance result records failure for the inconsistent classification.
acceptance.when: The routing acceptance verifier evaluates the Skill declaration and classification.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the routing declaration fixture marked as leaf and assert that acceptance verification fails for false leaf classification.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject a leaf classification whenever routing or orchestration behavior is declared.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema change; reverting the verifier restores prior classification behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Skill metadata moves from routing/leaf inconsistency to blocking acceptance failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Verification fails for routing-plus-leaf inconsistency while genuine leaf Skills remain eligible for leaf handling.

acceptance.given: A routing or orchestration Skill declares a reachable branch whose target is unresolved.

oracle.expected: Acceptance verification fails and identifies every unresolved declared reachable branch.
forbidden: Acceptance passes while a declared reachable branch is unresolved.
An unresolved branch is silently ignored or reclassified without an observable diagnostic.
oracle.observable: Verifier output contains a failing status and the unresolved branch identifier or identifiers.

acceptance.then: The acceptance result records failure for each unresolved declared reachable branch.
acceptance.when: The routing verifier resolves all declared reachable branch identifiers.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the routing fixture with one unresolved declared reachable branch and assert a failure naming that branch.

affected_subjects: Acceptance verification of declared routing branches
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require every declared reachable branch to resolve and report unresolved branches deterministically.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema change; reverting the verifier restores prior branch-resolution behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Declared branch graph moves from unresolved to fully resolved or blocking-invalid.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Verification fails when any declared reachable branch is unresolved and passes only when all declared branches resolve.
